_about: Routing passes for the rev 2 board, run by tools/route_rev2.py (make rev2-route). Each pass runs KiCadRoutingTools' route.py on the previous pass's board. Option names are route.py's own flags without the leading dashes; a list value becomes several arguments, true becomes a bare flag. Net lists can name a group with @group.

passes.name: row5
passes._why: ROW5 (the bottom row) has the longest run into the 32U4, 100 mm up through the key field; it routes first, on its own: even VBUS (which also runs to the 32U4's VBUS-sense pin) gets in its way otherwise.

passes.name: vbus
passes._why: VBUS's pin on the TPS2116 (VIN2) sits between two power pins at 0.5 mm pitch and loses out if anything else gets there first. The board generator pre-routes its escape to a via.

passes.name: usb-power
passes._why: The USB-C and TPS2116 pins are 0.5 mm apart, too tight for 0.25 mm clearance. Routing these before the matrix keeps the matrix from walling in the 32U4's USB pins.

passes.name: rows
passes._why: The eight row nets each run the width of the keyboard, the bottom row the furthest from the 32U4; routed before the columns they get first pick of the channels into the controller strip.

passes.name: matrix
passes._why: Everything else at 0.25 mm, which keeps tracks 0.25 mm from the MX pegs and centre holes.

passes.name: gnd
passes._why: Tie any pour islands the routing cut off back into the planes.

repair._why: While the connectivity check finds open nets, rip just those up and route them again, then tie GND up again.
